decision.observation: 7:20 pm, Sat. 6; the bobber is airborne near the rod tip (~0.62,0.18), line angled down toward the pond; the farmer stands at the pond's north-west bank.
decision.hypothesis: The bobber should land in the pond below; then a dip/'HIT!' cue followed by a C press yields a catch, as twice today.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, hold/release LMB to keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish (day 5), Joja Cola x2 (day 6).
